mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level directly reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate delayed monetary tightening, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 120) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 120, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer spending and economic activity, directly boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) and high consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000) indicate robust economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and RSAFS > 350,000, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized > 3.0%) signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0%, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
